name: M5Unit-BLDC
description: The `m5stack_unit_bldc` component drives an [M5Stack M5Unit-BLDC](https://docs.m5stack.com/en/unit/Unit-BLDC) brushless DC motor driver over [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/). The unit has its own microcontroller that runs the motor, so ESPHome uses its [I²C register protocol](https://m5stack-doc.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/772/Unit_BLDC_I2C_Protocol.pdf) to set the control mode, direction and motor details, to send a PWM duty cycle or a target RPM, and to read back the measured RPM, frequency and motor status. The [I²C Bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) must be set up first.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x65`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) if you need to use multiple I²C buses.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval to poll the `rpm`, `frequency` and `status` readings below. Defaults to `1s`.

config_entries.label: Model
config_entries.description: The motor model wired to the driver. One of `low_speed` or `high_speed`. Defaults to `low_speed`.

config_entries.label: Pole Pairs
config_entries.description: The number of pole pairs of the motor, from `1` to `255`. The unit uses this to turn its pulse frequency measurement into RPM, so a wrong value makes the `rpm` sensor and closed loop control wrong too.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this `m5stack_unit_bldc` component if you need multiple components, or want to reference it from a `number`, `select`, `sensor` or `text_sensor` platform entry.

config_entries.label: Direction
config_entries.description: The rotation direction at boot. One of `forward` or `backward`. Defaults to `forward`.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: The control mode. One of `open_loop` or `closed_loop`. Defaults to `open_loop`.

config_entries.label: PID
config_entries.description: PID gains for closed loop control, written to the unit at boot.

config_entries.label: Save To Flash
config_entries.description: Save the motor model, pole pairs and PID gains in the unit's own flash, so it keeps them without ESPHome. Defaults to `false`. To spare the unit's flash, ESPHome remembers what it saved and only writes the flash again when these settings change, not on every boot.
